title: G20 Watchdog Sounds Alarm: Privacy Rules Are Handcuffing Global Crypto Oversight
summary: The FSB has warned that privacy rules have complicated cross-border oversight and data sharing in crypto. Regulators have tightened KYC and Travel Rule enforcement, while Ethereum groups have proposed privacy tools. G20 Privacy Crypto debates have pressed for consistent cooperation. title: Iran Extends Internet Clampdown Beyond Wartime
summary: Since its brief June war with Israel, Iran has throttled internet traffic and jammed GPS, making day-to-day tasks online a struggle and prompting Iranians’ fears of greater surveillance.
